title: Hruday parity theorem, link-flip antisymmetry and the first-order Wilson mean with an itemized second-order remainder
selection_reason: The centered correlation's interaction shift is second order in tau by SU(2) Peter-Weyl parity, so roadmap goal 2 is re-targeted to the only first-order Wilson effect, the uncentered mean omega_tau(W)=tau/144+O(tau^2). A sign certificate needs the exact coefficient, an exact antisymmetry control and an itemized second-order remainder K_2 uniform in volume, from the same AM2 expansion admitted through AV1.
model: Same zero-selected patterned AQ subfamily as AV1 (selected triple (0,0,0), whole stars phi_b=-(tau/3) sum_f W_f, both signs |tau|<=10^-8, centered whole-star boxes, cover R={0,e_z}, Haar reference), the AV1-admitted state lemma and constants, fixed positive physical scales.

parameters.first_order_candidate: omega_tau(W)=+tau/144+r(tau) in alpha units under I1.5 (to be derived, not assumed)
parameters.flip_set: E={(p,x): p_y even} u {(p,y): p_z even} u {(p,z): p_x even}
parameters.aw2_coupling_rule: tau_AW2 = the largest element of the decade grid {10^-8, 10^-9, ...} with K_2^+ * tau <= 1/288 (half the first-order coefficient), K_2^+ the admitted exact-tier remainder constant; frozen here, never chosen after K_2 is seen

targets.sign_margin_at_cap: 1/(144 K_2^+ tau) >= 2 for accepted; else sign_certified_below_cap via the rule

required: 1. Parity theorem. Prove from SU(2) character multiplicities (Peter-Weyl on each link) that in the zero-selected subfamily every first-order term of omega(W^2), of the real-time correlation omega(W alpha_theta(W)) and of C(s)=<chi,e^{-sG}chi> vanishes: the state term (c^(1) against W^2 Omega_0 and against W alpha^0_theta(W) Omega_0), the Duhamel term and the energy term separately; show E[W^3]=0, E[W^2 W_f]=0 for every omitted f including f=W, E[W^2]=1/4, E[W^4]=1/8; show no omitted face maps the energy-24 multiplet vector W Omega_0 back into itself except through the identity component and that the first-order splitting of that multiplet is zero. Conclude C(s)=e^{-3s}/4+O(tau^2) and omega(W^2)=1/4+O(tau^2) with the O(tau^2) constants left to item 5 or explicitly unbounded. Cross-check (named, not a replacement): the Wilson face contains a free z link, so W is Haar-distributed under the reference (AQ2 section 5); use it to confirm E[W]=0, E[W^2]=1/4 independently of the character count.

2. Link-flip antisymmetry lemma. Define U_E as the unitary multiplying every link in E by the central element -1. Prove: U_E commutes with every Casimir and every original endpoint gauge action; every elementary plaquette of Z^3 meets E in an odd number of links (enumerate the three orientations by translation covariance); hence U_E H_N(tau,kappa) U_E^* = H_N(-tau,-kappa) for every centered whole-star box including on-site cutoff compressions, where kappa is the selected triple; at kappa=0 the finite ground vectors are covariant, omega_{N,-tau}(W)=-omega_{N,tau}(W), omega_{N,-tau}(W^2)=omega_{N,tau}(W^2) and the finite correlations C_N are even in tau; pass to AQ limits as a statement about the whole set of subsequential limits (state by state only along a common subsequence). State explicitly that oddness does not by itself make the remainder O(tau^3); any third-order remainder is a separate obligation, not assumed. Control: kappa nonzero must break the identity. The odd-intersection enumeration must cover all three orientations and all 49 omitted faces of a factor (full enumeration, not a sample).

3. First-order coefficient. Derive omega_tau(W)=2<W Omega_0, c^(1)>+O(tau^2) with c^(1) from the AV1-admitted expansion, evaluate it exactly under I1.5 (only f=W contributes; energy 3 in alpha units, 24 normalized; E[W^2]=1/4) to +tau/144 for tau>0, and re-derive the sign from the frozen convention; a wrong-face control (any omitted f not equal to W contributes zero at first order) and an orientation-invariance control.

4. Second-order remainder K_2, itemized and uniform in volume: the AM2 remainder term (352 J t or the sharper admitted form at the exact tier), the two-creation term, the straddling-support pairing with outside excitations, the outside-traced density term Tr_out|delta><delta|, the normalization term (state its order), and the multiplier for the overlap with W Omega_R (only the creation supported exactly on R overlaps; ||W Omega_R||=1/2; a factor 4 is accepted only if labelled conservative). Report K_2^+ as an exact rational for the exact tier and for the crude tier; every term names its tier; tier mixing rejected. Pin every itemized term to the enumeration (15 owner sets with multiplicities {1x5,2x3,3x2,4x3,10x2}, 82 faces meeting R, 16 touching both factors of R) and record ||W Omega_R||=1/2 as a positive exact control. Separate f=W (the Wilson face is itself one of the 21 omitted classes anchored at factor 0) from the 20 other omitted faces of that anchor throughout.

5. Sign-certificate feasibility. Evaluate whether K_2^+ tau <= 1/288 at tau=10^-8 (margin >= 2); apply the frozen AW2 coupling rule and report tau_AW2. No enclosure of omega(W) is admitted in this loop; that is AW2.

6. Consistency controls: sign flip tau->-tau flips the first-order coefficient (and, by item 2, the exact value); the AV1 bounds |omega(W)|<=D are compatible with tau/144 (D>=|tau|/144 at the exact tier); the Haar parity identities computed exactly from character tables (sympy is NOT allowed in the admission path; encode the finite character algebra in exact rationals).

7. Executable exact checker with every control id below implemented as a damaging mutation; claim flags continuum_claim:false, uniform_wilson_claim:false, resolved_interaction_shift:false (this loop certifies no enclosure), scientific_priority_verified:false, first_order_parity_claim:true only if item 1 is complete; byte-identical normal and -O replays; freeze with research/round32/tools/freeze.py.
8. Premise lists as declared; the reverse producer is isolated as in AV1 and must derive the parity theorem and the flip lemma from the character structure without the panel notes.

new_control_semantics.wilson_overlap_single_component: only c_R overlaps W Omega_R; a factor 4 is accepted only if labelled conservative
new_control_semantics.sign_convention_fixture: a one-plaquette exact fixture under I1.5 (labelled a finite graph) shows sign(<W>)=sign(tau) at first order
new_control_semantics.aw2_coupling_rule_prefrozen: tau_AW2 is computed by the frozen decade-grid rule from the reported K_2^+; any other choice is rejected
new_control_semantics.flip_set_odd_intersection: every plaquette orientation meets E in an odd number of links; an even-count mutation of E is rejected
new_control_semantics.flip_breaks_at_nonzero_kappa: with a nonzero selected triple the identity maps kappa to -kappa; claiming tau-antisymmetry there is rejected
new_control_semantics.flip_no_third_order_claim: oddness alone does not yield an O(tau^3) remainder; any such claim without a separate proof is rejected
new_control_semantics.wilson_face_separated: the proof and the checker distinguish f=W from the 20 other omitted faces anchored with it; merging them (or excluding W from the omitted set) is rejected
new_control_semantics.flip_nonzero_kappa_positive_demonstratio: a nonzero selected triple fixture shows U_E maps kappa to -kappa (positive demonstration), not merely a rejected claim

acceptance.limited: K_2^+ only at the crude tier, or the flip lemma proved only in finite volume, or one route fails; the dominating term named.
